The '''''Red Dragon''''' was an [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Imperial Star Destroyer]] that was presumably looking for [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] activity near an area where the [[BFF-1 bulk freighter/Legends|BFF-1 bulk freighter]] ''[[Op Mus]]'' was awaiting repairs from [[Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport|stormtrooper transport]] ''[[Jaamn]]''. It had a complement of [[TIE/ad starfighter|TIE Avengers]].

==Behind the scenes==
The ship only appears if the freighter ''Op Mus'' is destroyed.
